questions: In fully visible middle frames, are exactly three pens visible and stable on the white carrier?
For each pen, report cap marker status, cap end, exposed writing tip, and orientation.
Which pens, if any, have missing-cap evidence?
Which pens, if any, have wrong-orientation evidence?
Does the carrier motion look normal enough that the object inspection is reliable?

question_answers.evidence: Three distinct pens are clearly visible and stable on the white carrier plate in the middle frames (e.g., 00:06-00:09).

left_first.evidence: The pen lacks the black cap marker seen on the others; a pointed writing tip is visible at the bottom end.

middle_second.evidence: The black cap marker is present at the bottom end of the pen.

right_third.evidence: The black cap marker is present at the top end, which is opposite to the orientation of the middle pen.

detected_anomalies.evidence: The leftmost pen has no black cap marker; the writing tip is exposed at the bottom.
The rightmost pen has its cap at the top end, while the middle pen has its cap at the bottom end, indicating it is reversed relative to the standard arrangement.

parsed.reason: The left pen is missing its cap entirely (MISSING_CAP), and the right pen is oriented with the cap at the top while the middle pen has it at the bottom (WRONG_ORIENTATION).
